name: Block CFG and block ops
plain: Applies a guidance-like push between cond and uncond at chosen UNet blocks, in feature space instead of the output. Block ops let one write conditional scripts of operations such as scale, flip and FFT on block features.
math:
BlockCFG: at selected blocks with cond and uncond both in batch and even size: h_p ← h_p − scale·(h_p − h_s), p and s chosen by reverse flag (cond and uncond). Also on attention q,k,v via a forward wrapper.
BlockOps: rule list evaluated on block, stage and sigma; many op types (ops.py), read by name.

props.hook: input/output/after_skip patches; model_patchConditional; attn forward wrapper
